title: Revelation Chapter 11 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Revelation chapter 11 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Revelation Chapter 11 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Revelation Chapter 11.

questions.question: What was given to John in Revelation 11?
options: A reed like unto a rod
questions.correctAnswer: A reed like unto a rod
questions.explanation: John was given a reed like unto a rod to measure the temple of God (Revelation 11:1).

questions.question: In Revelation 11, how long will the holy city be trodden under foot?
questions.explanation: The holy city shall be tread under foot for forty and two months (Revelation 11:2).

questions.question: What will the two witnesses do during their prophecy?
questions.explanation: The two witnesses shall prophesy clothed in sackcloth (Revelation 11:3).

questions.question: What do the two witnesses represent in Revelation 11?
options: Two olive trees and two candlesticks
questions.correctAnswer: Two olive trees and two candlesticks
questions.explanation: The two witnesses are referred to as the two olive trees and the two candlesticks (Revelation 11:4).

questions.question: True or False: Fire proceeds out of the mouths of the two witnesses if anyone tries to hurt them.
questions.explanation: If any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth to devour their enemies (Revelation 11:5).

questions.question: What power do the two witnesses have in their prophecy?
options: To shut heaven and turn waters to blood
questions.correctAnswer: To shut heaven and turn waters to blood
questions.explanation: They have power to shut heaven so that it rain not and to turn waters to blood (Revelation 11:6).

questions.question: True or False: The beast will make war against the two witnesses and kill them.
questions.explanation: The beast shall make war against the two witnesses and shall overcome them and kill them (Revelation 11:7).

questions.question: What city is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt in Revelation 11?
questions.explanation: The great city where their dead bodies lie is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, where our Lord was crucified, which is Jerusalem (Revelation 11:8).

questions.question: True or False: The people will allow the dead bodies of the two witnesses to be buried.
questions.explanation: They shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves (Revelation 11:9).

questions.question: What will happen after three days and a half to the two witnesses?
options: They will be brought to heaven
questions.explanation: After three days and a half, the Spirit of life from God entered into them and they stood upon their feet (Revelation 11:11).

questions.question: In what manner will the two witnesses ascend to heaven?
questions.explanation: They ascended up to heaven in a cloud (Revelation 11:12).

questions.question: What occurred at the same hour when the two witnesses ascended?
questions.explanation: A great earthquake occurred at the same hour when the two witnesses ascended (Revelation 11:13).

questions.question: True or False: The nations were pleased when the two witnesses were killed.
questions.explanation: They that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them and make merry when the two witnesses are killed (Revelation 11:10).

questions.question: In Revelation 11, what is stated about the kingdoms of the world?
options: They will become the kingdoms of our Lord
They will be ruled by the beast
questions.correctAnswer: They will become the kingdoms of our Lord
questions.explanation: The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ (Revelation 11:15).

questions.question: What did the twenty-four elders do when they heard the voices in heaven?
questions.explanation: The four and twenty elders fell upon their faces and worshipped God (Revelation 11:16).

medium.title: Revelation Chapter 11 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Revelation Chapter 11 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What is the great city spiritually called in Revelation 11:8?
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:8 states that the great city is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, indicating its moral and spiritual condition.

questions.question: How long will the two witnesses prophesy according to Revelation 11:3?
options: One thousand two hundred and threescore days
questions.correctAnswer: One thousand two hundred and threescore days
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:3 specifies that the two witnesses will prophesy for one thousand two hundred and threescore days, which is equivalent to three and a half years.

questions.question: True or False: The inhabitants of the earth will mourn for the two witnesses when they are killed.
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:10 reveals that the people will rejoice and make merry over the death of the two prophets, not mourn.

questions.question: What happens after three days and a half according to Revelation 11:11?
options: The Spirit of life enters them
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit of life enters them
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:11 indicates that after three days and a half, the Spirit of life from God entered into the two witnesses, and they stood upon their feet.

questions.question: What does Revelation 11:13 say happened at the same hour as the resurrection of the witnesses?
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:13 mentions that a great earthquake occurred at the same hour that the two witnesses were resurrected, signifying God's power.

questions.question: True or False: The remnant were affrighted and gave glory to the God of heaven after the earthquake.
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:13 confirms that the remnant were affrighted and gave glory to God after witnessing the events surrounding the resurrection of the witnesses.

questions.question: What is the significance of the two witnesses being clothed in sackcloth as mentioned in Revelation 11:3?
questions.explanation: The sackcloth signifies mourning and repentance, indicating the serious message of the two witnesses during their prophetic ministry as stated in Revelation 11:3.

questions.question: According to Revelation 11:5, what happens if anyone tries to hurt the two witnesses?
options: Fire will proceed out of their mouth
questions.correctAnswer: Fire will proceed out of their mouth
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:5 states that if anyone attempts to hurt the two witnesses, fire will proceed from their mouths and devour their enemies.

questions.question: What does Revelation 11:14 indicate will happen after the second woe?
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:14 states that the second woe is past and that the third woe will come quickly, indicating imminent judgment.

questions.question: What does the seventh angel proclaim in Revelation 11:15?
options: The kingdoms of this world are finished
The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord
questions.correctAnswer: The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:15 proclaims that the kingdoms of this world have become the kingdoms of our Lord and His Christ, signifying His ultimate authority.

questions.question: How does Revelation 11:12 teach us about the assurance of believers' resurrection?
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:12 shows that the two witnesses were called up to heaven, which serves as an assurance that believers will also have a resurrection and ascension.

questions.question: True or False: The witnesses' dead bodies will be honored and buried according to the customs of the people.
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:9 states that the people will not suffer the dead bodies of the witnesses to be put in graves, indicating dishonor rather than respect.

questions.question: What does Revelation 11:18 signify about God's judgment?
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:18 indicates that God's wrath has come, and the time of judgment for the dead is at hand, signifying the inevitability of His justice.

hard.title: Revelation Chapter 11 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Revelation Chapter 11.

questions.question: What does the seventh angel proclaim when he sounds the trumpet?
options: The kingdoms of this world have become the kingdoms of our Lord
The time of judgment has come
questions.correctAnswer: The kingdoms of this world have become the kingdoms of our Lord
questions.explanation: This is stated in Revelation 11:15, where it says, 'The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.'

questions.question: What action do the twenty-four elders take upon hearing the proclamation of the seventh angel?
options: They fall upon their faces and worship God
questions.correctAnswer: They fall upon their faces and worship God
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:16 describes how the four and twenty elders 'fell upon their faces, and worshipped God.'

questions.question: According to Revelation 11:17, how do the elders address God?
questions.explanation: In Revelation 11:17, the elders say, 'We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty.'

questions.question: What event occurs immediately after the two witnesses are resurrected?
options: A voice calls them to heaven
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:13 states, 'And the same hour was there a great earthquake...'.

questions.question: What does Revelation 11:18 reveal about the nations in response to God's wrath?
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:18 mentions, 'And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come...'.

questions.question: Which significant event occurs in heaven according to Revelation 11:19?
options: The ark of his testament is seen
The throne of God is revealed
questions.correctAnswer: The ark of his testament is seen
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:19 notes, 'And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament.'

questions.question: The two witnesses are described as what in Revelation 11:4?
options: Two olive trees and two candlesticks
questions.correctAnswer: Two olive trees and two candlesticks
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:4 states, 'These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.'

questions.question: What power do the two witnesses have according to Revelation 11:6?
options: To shut heaven and turn waters to blood
questions.correctAnswer: To shut heaven and turn waters to blood
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:6 states, 'These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not... and have power over waters to turn them to blood...'.

questions.question: What does Revelation 11:10 tell us about the reaction of the people to the two witnesses?
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:10 describes the people as rejoicing and making merry over the two prophets, as they 'tormented them that dwelt on the earth.'

questions.question: What does the term 'great city' refer to in Revelation 11:8?
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:8 states that the great city is spiritually referred to as 'Sodom and Egypt.'

questions.question: True or False: The two witnesses lay dead for four days before being resurrected.
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:9 states they were seen dead for 'three days and a half', not four days.

questions.question: True or False: The seventh angel's proclamation includes the eternal reign of Christ.
questions.explanation: Revelation 11:15 affirms that Christ 'shall reign for ever and ever.'

questions.question: Which Old Testament event does the resurrection of the two witnesses echo?
questions.explanation: The resurrection of the two witnesses parallels the vision of dry bones in Ezekiel 37, where God brings the dead to life.

questions.question: What does the Greek word for 'witnesses' (martus) imply about their role?
questions.explanation: The term 'witnesses' signifies those who testify to the truth, and in the context of Revelation, they often face death for their testimony.

questions.question: What literary device is primarily used when the elders worship God in a structured manner?
questions.explanation: The elders' worship includes parallel phrases that reflect their reverence for God's eternal nature, as seen in Revelation 11:17.

theological.title: Revelation Chapter 11 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Revelation Chapter 11 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What is the purpose of measuring the temple of God according to Revelation 11:1?
questions.explanation: The angel instructs to measure the temple and the altar, specifically noting those that worship therein, indicating the focus on the worshippers themselves (Revelation 11:1).

questions.question: How long will the holy city be tread under foot by the Gentiles according to Revelation 11:2?
questions.explanation: The text states that the holy city shall be trodden under foot for forty and two months, indicating a specific time of oppression (Revelation 11:2).

questions.question: What will the two witnesses be clothed in according to Revelation 11:3?
questions.explanation: The two witnesses are described as prophesying while clothed in sackcloth, which symbolizes mourning and repentance (Revelation 11:3).

questions.question: What power do the two witnesses possess according to Revelation 11:6?
options: To shut heaven and turn waters to blood
questions.correctAnswer: To shut heaven and turn waters to blood
questions.explanation: The witnesses have the authority to shut heaven so that it does not rain and to turn waters into blood, showcasing their prophetic power (Revelation 11:6).

questions.question: What happens to the two witnesses after they finish their testimony according to Revelation 11:7?
options: They are killed by the beast
They are celebrated by the people
questions.correctAnswer: They are killed by the beast
questions.explanation: Once their testimony is complete, the beast from the bottomless pit makes war against them and kills them, representing opposition to God's messengers (Revelation 11:7).

questions.question: Where are the dead bodies of the two witnesses left according to Revelation 11:8?
options: In the street of the great city
questions.correctAnswer: In the street of the great city
questions.explanation: Their bodies lie in the street of the great city, which is symbolically referred to as Sodom and Egypt, signifying spiritual decay and rebellion (Revelation 11:8).

questions.question: What reaction do people have to the deaths of the two witnesses according to Revelation 11:10?
options: They send gifts to one another
questions.correctAnswer: They send gifts to one another
questions.explanation: The inhabitants of the earth rejoice and send gifts to one another, celebrating the demise of the prophets who had tormented them (Revelation 11:10).

questions.question: What event occurs after three and a half days according to Revelation 11:11?
questions.explanation: After three and a half days, the Spirit of life from God enters the witnesses, and they stand on their feet, indicating a miraculous resurrection (Revelation 11:11).

questions.question: What happens immediately after the two witnesses ascend to heaven according to Revelation 11:13?
questions.explanation: The verse states that a great earthquake occurs in the same hour as their ascension, signifying divine judgment (Revelation 11:13).

questions.question: What is revealed about God's sovereignty in Revelation 11:15?
options: The kingdoms of the world become His
questions.correctAnswer: The kingdoms of the world become His
questions.explanation: The seventh angel declares that the kingdoms of this world are now the kingdoms of the Lord and His Christ, emphasizing His ultimate sovereignty (Revelation 11:15).

questions.question: What attribute of God is highlighted in Revelation 11:17?
questions.explanation: The elders give thanks to God Almighty, recognizing His great power and reign, which reflects His omnipotence (Revelation 11:17).

questions.question: What does Revelation 11:18 indicate about the time of judgment?
options: It is a time of mercy
It is a time of reward for prophets and saints
It is a time of celebration
It is a time of peace
questions.correctAnswer: It is a time of reward for prophets and saints
questions.explanation: The verse states that it is the time for the dead to be judged and for God to reward His servants, indicating a solemn time of judgment (Revelation 11:18).

questions.question: How does Revelation 11:19 contribute to our understanding of God's presence?
options: God is only in the temple
questions.explanation: The temple of God is opened in heaven, revealing God's presence with lightnings and voices, which signifies His powerful presence (Revelation 11:19).

questions.question: What doctrinal insight can be drawn from Revelation 11:5-6 regarding divine judgment?
questions.explanation: The power bestowed upon the witnesses to defend themselves against harm illustrates God's protective nature over His prophets during their time of ministry (Revelation 11:5-6).

questions.question: According to Revelation 11:12-13, what does the ascension of the witnesses indicate about the final victory of God?
options: It confirms God's authority over creation
It shows the impotence of God's enemies
It reveals the end of prophecy
questions.correctAnswer: It confirms God's authority over creation
questions.explanation: The witnesses' ascension to heaven in a cloud signifies God's ultimate authority and the victory of His purposes over opposition (Revelation 11:12-13).
